newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market not tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market not tested - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested, USDA said. Few bids of $105.00-$106.00 per cwt on a dressed basis available, but showlists well depleted at this time and sellers content to wait until next week to trade more stock. Weekly volume 107,200.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
Confirmed - None Last Week - 1,400 Last Year - 7,900
Wk To Date -None. Sm Pd Lst Wk - None. Sm Pd Lst Yr - None.
